c: p:fire emblem mystery of the emblem
d:
A collection of Meepupu's works that were posted on patreon (which has not been updated since december 2025). THis gallery does not intend to be a comprehensive collection of all of the artist's works, as I'm aware that there's likely several image sequences that were exclusively in the dropbox links that were distributed monthly, and thus I do not have access to. This gallery otherwise only contains what was either posted directly on Patreon, or recovered from the links posted on kemono. Several galleries on ehentai have a good chunk of the artist's works already, but this one aims to also include the wip versions of images that were posted on patreon. This gallery doesn't include what's only been posted on the artist's social media and other platforms. There's also a few other galleries already on this site that covers a good chunk of Meep's art.

The pictures are organized roughly in the order they were published in. Several sequences may not be in a consistent order, and sequences that were completed over the course of several months were placed in order of their respective sequence rather than what month they were originally posted in.
